notes: low-load controls (0.34x and 0.17x nominal capacity, i.e. ~0.7x and ~0.34x the measured realized capacity of ~1.6 req/s). Added after measuring that realized capacity, before any policy run completed, to bracket a genuinely unloaded regime. Limited to 150 requests because low load means a long arrival span. All cells limited in request count and capped at max_running=48 (the padded-cache rebuild needs about twice the KV when the padded batch is transient; max_running=96 hit CUDA OOM at ~1.9k context). Caps are identical for every policy.
